models.name: Logistic Regression
models.purpose_zh: 應用於二元分類問題，預測事件發生的機率。
models.purpose_en: Applied to binary classification problems, predicting the probability of an event's occurrence.

models.name: Support Vector Machine
models.purpose_zh: 透過在高維度空間建構超平面，將資料區分為兩類。
models.purpose_en: Classifies data by constructing a hyperplane in a high-dimensional feature space.

models.name: Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines
models.purpose_zh: 透過基本函數的近似與加權，建構具可調整與彈性的非線性預測模式，用於分類問題。
models.purpose_en: Constructs adjustable and flexible non-linear prediction models through approximation and weighting of basis functions, applied to classification problems.

models.name: eXtreme Gradient Boosting
models.purpose_zh: 透過順序構建多個決策樹以糾正先前模型的缺陷，並使用正則化避免過度擬合，以生成準確的預測模型。
models.purpose_en: Sequentially builds multiple decision trees to correct defects in previous models, and uses regularization to prevent overfitting, generating accurate prediction models.
